metaTitle: Tasks, chat, meetings and code. One workspace
metaDescription: PDA: open-source project management. Tasks, chat, video meetings and GitHub tracking in one workspace. Run it on your own server.
heroDescription: Drop the scattered tools. Bring your project and your team into PDA.
heroPreviewLabel: The PDA workspace: the task board of a project.
stackBody: Tasks live in one place, chat in another, meetings behind a link, code on a different site. The team wanders between tools instead of doing the work.
stackSr: An animation of four separate tools merging into PDA.
meetingTitle: Send a link. Guests join without an account.
meetingBody: Start a meeting tied to a project or on its own. The team enters the room, and anyone outside joins as a guest with just the link.
meetingSr: The PDA meeting screen: one live meeting, participant tiles, microphone and camera controls, and two upcoming meetings.
chatTitle: Project chat. Direct messages. Files too.
chatBody: Every project has its own group chat. Write one to one with anyone and drop files straight into the conversation.
chatSr: The PDA project chat: three messages, a reaction, a PDF attachment and a typing indicator.
taskTitle: Simple task. Advanced task. Your call.
taskBody: A title is enough for a small job. A big one brings assignees, priority, dates and subtasks. Same form, one tap to switch.
taskQuiet: Sprints, Kanban, calendar and reminders are ready too.
taskSr: The PDA task form. Simple mode shows a title and a description; advanced mode adds assignees, priority and more fields.
repoBody: Connect a GitHub repository. Basic mode follows the main branch. Advanced mode shows branches and unmerged commits. The team hears about every new commit.
repoSr: The PDA repository screen. Basic mode lists the latest commits of the main branch; advanced mode shows branches and unmerged commits. A new commit notification appears.
orgTitle: Set up your organization. Keep projects under one roof.
orgBody: A club, a team or a company: its own profile, logo and cover in one place.
orgSr: A PDA organization profile and an organization card.
sourceTitle:
The code is open.
The server is yours.
sourceDescription: Apache 2.0 licensed. Install it on your own server with Docker and keep your data.
envOutput: Fill in the required local settings, save and close.
contributeBody: Report a bug, suggest an idea, send code.
finalBody: Sign up, open your project, invite your team.
projectAbout: An open-source project management platform for students
teamAbout: From idea to first delivery, together.
demoCommit1: Add guest join link for meetings
demoCommit5: Move task status to the sidebar

demoChat1: The sign-in flow is ready, opening the pull request now.
demoChat3: Great, let us merge it today.
demoOrgAbout: A community where students build projects together.
